notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a THIRD, independent synthetic application (Prairie Wind Medical Gases, LLC) against the same true_requirements.json as data/36C26326Q0197 -- built specifically to add another contradictory example of a fresh shape (a past-performance dollar-value conflict: a $460,000 contract value stated in the Technical Capability narrative versus $395,000 stated for the same named contract in the Past Performance section), distinct from application.txt's Schedule-of-Items-completeness contradiction and application_b.txt's supply-chain-sourcing contradiction on this tender.

Most other topics are given straightforward compliant treatment in this variant since the goal of this pass is specifically to add contradictory-class density and format diversity, not to re-exercise every failure shape again.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.description: Offerors must be registered and active in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of offer.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- genuine SAM registration status cannot be confirmed from application text.

verdicts.description: The contractor must comply with the delivery frequencies specified per delivery location as outlined in Attachment A.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly commits to complying with the delivery frequency specified per location in Attachment A.

evidence.quote:
We commit to complying with the
delivery frequency specified per location in Attachment A.

verdicts.description: The contractor must have a facility and/or resources physically located in the geographic areas in which they will provide supplies.
verdicts.rationale: Application states staffed depots in Sioux Falls, SD and Fargo, ND, placing resources within the geographic areas served.

evidence.quote:
Prairie Wind Medical Gases operates staffed depots in Sioux Falls, SD
and Fargo, ND, placing resources within each of the geographic areas
served under this solicitation.

verdicts.description: The contractor's proposal must include the cylinder replacement cost for each item listed on Attachment C.
verdicts.rationale: Application states an itemized cylinder replacement cost schedule per gas type and cylinder size is attached.

evidence.quote:
Prairie Wind Medical Gases will invoice the replacement cost listed in
our attached cylinder replacement cost schedule (Exhibit C-1), itemized
per gas type and cylinder size.

verdicts.description: The contractor must submit a cylinder tracking plan with their proposal for cylinders being delivered to and from the ordering activity, covering data-entry method and mechanism, when and how the Government can extract data, what data is stored, access limits, and any Government-network connection requirements. If the contractor's tracking system is impending/not yet fully operational, the proposal must include an implementation timeline coinciding with the phase-in timeline.
verdicts.rationale: Application describes a web-based portal tracking plan addressing data-entry method/mechanism, on-demand data access, access limits, and the absence of a Government-network connection requirement.

evidence.quote:
we will use a
web-based portal (method: barcode scanning at pickup and delivery,
Microsoft Excel export available) that allows ordering activity POCs
on-demand access to view or extract data related to all cylinders
moving in and out of their facility, including access limits for
Government employees and no requirement for connection to the
Government network.

verdicts.description: Although not required, if the contractor has a system for tracking medical gas cylinders within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, the contractor must submit a tracking plan with their proposal covering the same items as the delivery-side tracking plan.
verdicts.rationale: This sub-requirement is conditional on the contractor having a facility-side tracking system after delivery. The application affirmatively states it does not operate such a system, so the condition never applies.

evidence.quote:
We do not currently operate a system for tracking medical gas cylinders
within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, and are
therefore not submitting a facility-side tracking plan with this
proposal.

verdicts.description: The contractor must submit in their proposal their available on-demand reporting capabilities (usage, cost, and cylinder tracking reports), including how the data is collected, distributed, and viewed.
verdicts.rationale: Application describes on-demand usage, cost, and cylinder-tracking reporting through a web portal, and states how the data is viewed (web portal or Excel export).

evidence.quote:
Prairie Wind Medical Gases will provide on-demand usage, cost, and
cylinder-tracking reports through the same web-based portal referenced
above

verdicts.description: The contractor must identify in their proposal any medical gases that can be classified as difficult to fill or likely to be placed on backorder, by highlighting the item in Attachment C and providing a statement justifying the classification.
verdicts.rationale: Application identifies a specific item (liquid helium, Item 0047) as difficult to fill and provides a justifying statement.

evidence.quote:
We identify liquid helium (Item 0047 in Attachment C) as difficult to
fill and likely to be placed on backorder

verdicts.description: The contractor must submit a Project Management Plan (PMP) with their proposal demonstrating understanding of the scope, schedule, and service level requirements, including at minimum a communications and task matrix, an identified individual responsible for deliverables, a preliminary delivery/install/user acceptance schedule, a time estimate per critical task, an outline of progress-tracking processes, and an approach to identifying and resolving potential project problems.
verdicts.rationale: Application's PMP addresses all six required elements: communications/task matrix, responsible individual, preliminary schedule, time estimates, progress-tracking outline, and problem-identification/resolution approach.

evidence.quote:
Our Project Management Plan includes a communications and task matrix
identifying key contractor personnel and their roles and
responsibilities; designates our Operations Manager as the individual
responsible for contract deliverables and on-time performance; provides
a preliminary delivery, installation, and user acceptance schedule with
task dependencies; estimates the time required for each critical task
in workdays; outlines our process for tracking and communicating
delivery progress and documenting equipment acceptance; and describes
our approach to identifying early warning signs of potential project
problems and our escalation and resolution process.

verdicts.description: Offeror must provide procedures or documentation demonstrating the ability to navigate through emergency situations, shortages, and any other form of supply chain interruptions.
verdicts.rationale: Application describes backup supply agreements with two independent fillers enabling rerouting within 24 hours, with no conflicting statement elsewhere.

We maintain backup supply agreements with two

verdicts.description: Offeror must demonstrate the innovative use of a cylinder tracking and management system, as part of the Technical Capability narrative.
verdicts.rationale: Application describes its barcode-based cylinder tracking and management system as an innovative approach to accountability.

evidence.quote:
We employ a barcode-based cylinder tracking and
management system, described above, representing an innovative
approach to accountability across the ordering activity network.

verdicts.description: Offeror must provide proof that all medical gases conform to USP and National Formulary specifications and that the contractor and its medical gas manufacturers/fillers are registered with the FDA.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- genuine USP/National Formulary conformance and FDA registration cannot be confirmed from the application's own representation.

verdicts.description: Offerors must provide past performance references for work performed within the past three years relevant to the complexity, size, and scope of this requirement, listing at minimum: contract or project number and title, period of performance, dollar value, brief description/scope, name of agency/facility, and point of contact.
verdicts.rationale: The Technical Capability narrative describes a five-year, $460,000 medical gas supply contract with the Fargo VA Medical Center, but the Past Performance section states the same Fargo VA Medical Center Medical Gas Supply Agreement had a dollar value of $395,000 -- the two stated contract values for the same referenced contract conflict.

evidence.quote:
our five-year, $460,000 medical gas supply contract
with the Fargo VA Medical Center

Contract/Project: Fargo VA Medical Center Medical Gas Supply Agreement.
Period of Performance: 2019-2024. Dollar Value: $395,000.

verdicts.description: Offerors must provide a phase-in strategy including at minimum a Project Communications Plan, an Implementation Plan, and a Delivery Plan with milestone dates or timelines demonstrating the ability to meet the effective date of the contract or the 60 calendar day requirement.
verdicts.rationale: Application's phase-in strategy addresses all three required components: Project Communications Plan, Implementation Plan, and Delivery Plan with milestone dates.

evidence.quote:
Our phase-in strategy includes a Project Communications Plan
identifying our Operations Manager as the point of contact for all
phase-in and ongoing contract communications, an Implementation Plan
describing depot staffing and cylinder-inventory buildup during the
phase-in period, and a Delivery Plan with milestone dates demonstrating
our ability to meet the effective date of the contract.

verdicts.description: To receive Veterans Involvement evaluation credit, an offeror must be listed at the time of submission of offers and at time of award as a certified SDVOSB/VOSB in the SBA certification database.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- whether the offeror is genuinely listed in the SBA certification database cannot be confirmed from application text.

verdicts.description: If the offeror is a large business proposing to use certified SDVOSBs or VOSBs as subcontractors and elects to receive evaluation consideration under this factor, the proposal must state the names of the certified SDVOSB/VOSB subcontractors, a description of their services/supplies, and approximate dollar values.
verdicts.rationale: This sub-requirement only applies to a large business electing SDVOSB/VOSB subcontractor credit; the application states all work will be performed with the offeror's own personnel with no subcontractors, so the triggering condition does not apply.

evidence.quote:
Prairie Wind Medical Gases will perform 100% of the work identified in
the Statement of Work and Contract Administration with its own
personnel and equipment; no subcontractors, similarly situated
entities, or other performing parties are proposed.

verdicts.rationale: Application states 100% of the work will be performed by the prime contractor with no subcontractors, which is itself the required breakdown of who performs the work.

evidence.quote:
Prairie Wind Medical Gases will perform 100% of the work identified in
the Statement of Work and Contract Administration with its own
personnel and equipment; no subcontractors, similarly situated
entities, or other performing parties are proposed.
